title: 6L Live PlmCasX Expression & Purification
author: Liz O'Brien
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8srhwd6
materials: Drain liquid. Collect flow-through for gel electrophoresis.
In a separate beaker, mix together the following reagents:

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer + TCEP
steps.instruction: Prepare 160 mL of Lysis Buffer + TCEP using MilliQ water as the solvent.

substeps.instruction: Add 8 Roche cOmplete protease inhibitor tablets.
Add 16 µL RNase-free DNase.
Add PMSF to a final concentration of 0.5 mM (800 µL of 100 mM stock PMSF).
Add TCEP to a final concentration of 0.5 mM (80 µL of 1 M stock TCEP).
Fill to a final volume of 160 mL using MilliQ water.

steps.title: Prepare IEX Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare IEX Buffer A and Buffer B using MilliQ water as the solvent.

substeps.instruction: IEX Buffer A: 50 mM HEPES (pH 7.5), 500 mM NaCl, 10% volume glycerol, and 0.5 mM TCEP.
IEX Buffer B: 50 mM HEPES (pH 7.5), 2 M NaCl, 10% volume glycerol, and 0.5 mM TCEP.

steps.title: Set Up Pre-culture
steps.instruction: Establish a pre-culture aseptically next to a Bunsen burner.

substeps.instruction: Transform plasmid into Rosetta cells or use a small amount from a glycerol stock.
Add 200 mL LB broth to a 500 mL baffled Erlenmeyer flask.
Add Ampicillin to a final concentration of 50 mg/L (200 µL of 50 mg/mL Ampicillin).
Add the entire tube of transformed cells to the flask.
Shake at 37 °C, 160–180 rpm overnight.

steps.title: Scale Up Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate TB broth and grow cells aseptically next to a Bunsen burner.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 L TB broth to each of 6 glass or plastic baffled 1 L flasks.
Add Ampicillin to a final concentration of 50 mg/L (1 mL of 50 mg/mL amp per flask).
Add 20–25 mL of LB pre-culture to each TB flask.
Shake at 37 °C, 160–180 rpm until OD600 is between 0.5–0.6 (approx. 3–6 hours), blanking the spectrophotometer with clean media.

steps.title: Induce Protein Expression
steps.instruction: Induce expression using IPTG and incubate at low temperature.

substeps.instruction: Transfer TB flasks to ice.
Add IPTG to a final concentration of 1 mM (1 mL 1 M IPTG per flask).
Shake at 16 °C, 160–180 rpm overnight.

steps.title: Harvest and Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Collect cells and perform chemical lysis.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cultures to 1 L plastic centrifuge tubes and balance with MilliQ H2O.
Centrifuge in a Beckman Coulter J6-MI at 4000 rpm for 20 minutes at 4 °C using blue sleeves.
Pour off supernatant.
Add 20 mL Lysis Buffer + TCEP to each tube.
Vortex using a flat-top vortex until homogenous.
Transfer cell suspension to a 500 mL beaker (Alternatively: transfer to 5 mL tubes, centrifuge at 4000 rpm for 20 min at 4 °C, pour off supernatant, and freeze pellet at -20 °C).

steps.title: Sonicate Sample
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt cells via sonication in the cold room.

substeps.instruction: Add the solution of tablets + PMSF + DNase to the cell suspension.
Place the beaker in a tube of ice water for stability.
Rinse sonicator tip with ethanol, then H2O.
Sonicate at 5.5 power setting for 5 minutes, cycling 10 seconds on and 15 seconds off.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Remove cellular debris via high-speed centrifugation and filtration.

substeps.instruction: Divide sonicated sample between 6 capped plastic ultracentrifuge tubes on ice, matching pairs within +/- 0.01 g using MilliQ H2O.
Centrifuge in a Beckman Coulter Avanti J-E at 35,000 rpm for 45 minutes at 4 °C.
Filter the sonicated sample through a 0.22 μm bottle-top filter and store on ice.

steps.title: Ni-NTA Affinity Purification
steps.instruction: Bind and elute protein using Ni-NTA resin in a 4 °C cold room.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 mL Qiagen Ni-NTA resin to a yellow gravity column with a butterfly valve.
Wash the column 5 times with 10 mL Lysis Buffer + TCEP.
Add 10 mL Lysis Buffer + TCEP to the column and mix with a pipette.
Transfer Ni-NTA resin to a bottle containing the filtered sample and a stir bar; stir at 4 °C for at least 2 hours.
Return the resin/sample mixture to the yellow gravity column.
Wash with 50 mL Lysis Buffer + TCEP, followed by 10 mL Lysis Buffer + TCEP.
Add 2 mg/mL TEV protease (4 eppendorfs of 250 µL lab stock), mix well, and incubate at 4 °C overnight.
Elute the column into a 50 mL Falcon tube (label as 'flow-through') and keep on ice.
Wash the column 3 times with 10 mL Elution Buffer (500 mM imidazole), collecting each elution in labeled 50 mL Falcon tubes.
Perform a final wash with 10 mL Lysis Buffer + TCEP four times.

steps.title: Concentrate Protein
steps.instruction: Concentrate the pooled fractions using Amicon concentrators.

substeps.instruction: Pool fractions into 15 mL 50 kDa MWCO Amicon Concentrators.
Centrifuge at 4000 rpm, 4 °C until volume is < 4 mL.
Transfer to 4 mL 30 kDa MWCO Amicon Concentrator and centrifuge until volume is < 500 µL.

steps.title: Cation Exchange Chromatography (SP Column)
steps.instruction: Purify protein using an Äkta system with a 5 mL SP column.

substeps.instruction: Attach a 5 mL SP column to the Äkta port using wet connections; set pre-column pressure alarm to 0.5 MPa.
Equilibrate with 40 mL IEX A Buffer (5–10 column volumes at 1–5 mL/min).
Detach column (run Äkta at 0.25 mL/min).
Draw 500 µL sample into a 1 mL syringe with a threaded luer lock and remove air.
Manually inject sample into the top of the SP column (do not exceed 5 mL/min).
Re-attach column (run Äkta at 0.25 mL/min) and insert a 96 deep well plate into position 3.
Run the SP column gradient program between IEX Buffer A and B to elute.
Collect chromatogram peak fractions, concentrate if necessary, and save for gel electrophoresis.

steps.title: Size Exclusion Chromatography (SEC)
steps.instruction: Perform final polishing using a Superdex 200 10/300 Increase column.

substeps.instruction: Attach a 24 mL S200 10/300 Increase column (run Äkta at 0.25 mL/min); operate at 0.5 mL/min with 2.8 MPa pre-column pressure.
Add a 500 µL loop to the Äkta.
Inject 3 mL SEC Buffer into the loop using a 5 mL syringe with a red luer lock.
Draw sample into a 1 mL syringe with a red luer lock and inject (< 500 µL) into the loop, leaving the syringe attached.
Run the SEC program (Method Editor > New > Gel Filtration > Superdex 200 10/300 Increase).
Collect chromatogram fractions, concentrate as necessary, and save for gel.

steps.title: Storage
steps.instruction: Flash freeze the final protein in liquid nitrogen and store.
